title: Multi-Seq: Clean Nuclei Preparation Protocol
author: Luciano G Martelotto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bejyjcpw
materials: In the final wash resuspend in 80 µL of chilled Wash Buffer supplemented with 0.2 U/μl - 0.5 U/μl of RNAse Inhibitor (Protector RNAse Inhibitor, Cat. RNAINH-RO, Merck/Roche). One may use RNAse inhibitor all the way, but it becomes expensive. I use RNAse Inhibitor during cell lysis, and in this final resuspension and RNA/cDNA quality looks good.
Count using Countess II Automated Cell Counter.
Left panel inlet shows PCR bubble.

steps.title: Prepare Clean Nuclei
steps.instruction: Obtain clean nuclei preparations to prevent CMO binding to debris. Use either a sucrose gradient or Fluorescence-Activated Nuclei Sorting (FANS) using DAPI, 7-AAD, or DRAQ-7 staining.

substeps.instruction: Visually inspect nuclei under a brightfield optical microscope (40x-60x magnification) before and after sorting.
Check for intact edges; discard samples showing damaged nuclei, partially lysed cells, disorganized chromatin, or blebbing.

steps.title: Prepare Anchor and Barcoded Oligo Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10x stock solution of the duplex by mixing Anchor and Barcoded oligos in a 1:1 molar ratio in PBS (no Ca2+/Mg2+).

substeps.instruction: Prepare at either 0.8 µM or 2 µM concentration.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend and Sort Nuclei
steps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in Washing Buffer [PBS (no Ca2+/Mg2+) + 1% BSA (Miltenyi Cat. 130-091-376)].

substeps.instruction: If using FANS: Sort ~140,000 events to obtain ~100,000 nuclei into 50 µL of Washing Buffer in a 96-well culture plate or LoBind 1.5 mL eppis tube.
If FANS is not used: Resuspend nuclei directly in 180 µL Washing Buffer.
After sorting, transfer nuclei to a 1.5 mL LoBind eppis tube and bring the final volume to ~180 µL using chilled Wash Buffer (use additional volume to wash the sorting well).

steps.title: Label Nuclei with Anchor-Barcode Oligo
steps.instruction: Add Anchor-Barcode oligo to the nuclei to achieve the required molar ratio (typically 40 pmol or 100 pmol CMO per 500,000 nuclei).

substeps.instruction: For 100,000 nuclei: Add 10 µL of 0.8 µM (8 pmol) or 10 µL of 2 µM (20 pmol) Anchor-Barcode oligo to reach a volume of ~190 µL.
For 500,000 nuclei: Add 20 µL of 2 µM CMO for a final concentration of 200 nM in 200 µL final volume.
Mix gently but thoroughly using a wide-bore tip.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Label Nuclei with Co-Anchor
steps.instruction: Add Co-Anchor oligo to the mixture to reach the final volume of 200 µL.

substeps.instruction: Add 8 pmol or 20 pmol Co-Anchor (matching the amount of Anchor-Barcode oligo used).
Mix gently and thoroughly.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash Nuclei
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to remove unbound oligos.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of chilled Wash Buffer and mix by inverting 3 times.
Remove supernatant, leaving ~20-30 µL to avoid losing nuclei.
Repeat the wash 2 more times using 1.2 mL of chilled Wash Buffer (do not resuspend nuclei between washes).

steps.title: Quantify and Pool Nuclei
steps.instruction: Verify nuclei count and prepare for GEM formation.

substeps.instruction: Count nuclei using Countess II Automated Cell Counter with Trypan Blue or Ethidium Homodimer.
Combine nuclei from multiple samples to multiplex.
Filter the pooled nuclei through a 40-µm Flowmi® Cell Strainer.

steps.title: cDNA Amplification and Initial Cleanup
steps.instruction: Proceed with GEM formation and RT per 3' v3.x workflow until cDNA amplification. Elute cDNA in 35 µL.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 34 µL of cDNA onto cDNA Amplification mix supplemented with 1 µL of 2.5 µM Multi-Seq Additive primer.
Perform cDNA amplification and 0.6X SPRI clean-up according to 3' v3.x workflow.

steps.title: Enrich Barcode DNA
steps.instruction: Recover the barcode DNA from the supernatant of the 0.6X SPRI cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.4X SPRI to the supernatant to achieve a final volume of 2X SPRI (e.g., add 140 µL SPRI to 60 µL existing SPRI/supernatant for a 300 µL total).
Transfer to a low-bind 1.5 mL tube and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnet for ~2 minutes until clear; discard supernatant.
Wash once: Add 400 µL 80% Ethanol, stand for 30 seconds, then discard.
Centrifuge briefly, return to magnet, and discard remaining ethanol.
Resuspend beads in 50 µL water.

steps.title: Secondary Barcode Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a second 2X SPRI purification to further clean the barcode DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL SPRI reagent directly to resuspended beads, mix, and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnet for ~2 minutes until clear; discard supernatant.
Wash twice: Add 200 µL 80% Ethanol, stand for 30 seconds, and discard (repeat twice).
Centrifuge briefly, return to magnet, discard remaining ethanol, and air-dry beads for 2 minutes (do not over-dry).
Resuspend beads in 40 µL water or EB, pipette vigorously, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place on magnet and transfer the clear supernatant to a PCR tube.

steps.title: Indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the barcode DNA using the following PCR reaction: 50 µL Kapa HiFi HotStart ReadyMix (2X), 5 µL 10 µM SI Primer (e.g. 3' v3.1, PN 2000095), 5 µL 10 µM RPIx primer, and either 3.5 ng barcode DNA, 5 µL of material, or the entire volume (~40 µL), with nuclease-free water to 50 µL final volume.

substeps.instruction: Run cycling conditions: 95 °C for 5 min; then 20s at 98 °C, 30s at 60 °C, 30s at 72 °C (repeat 6-10 cycles); final extension 72 °C for 5 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean the indexing PCR product using SPRI beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 160 µL (1.6X) SPRI to each PCR product, mix thoroughly, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnet (High), wait for solution to clear, and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice on magnet (High) with 200 µL 80% ethanol, standing for 30 seconds between washes.
Centrifuge briefly, place on magnetic rack (Low), remove remaining ethanol with P20 pipette, and air-dry for 2 minutes.
Resuspend beads in 25 µL buffer EB, pipette thoroughly, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Return to magnet (Low), wait for solution to clear, and transfer supernatant to a PCR strip tube.

steps.title: Quality Control and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Quantify and analyze the barcode library.

substeps.instruction: Quantify concentration (1:5 - 1:10) using Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA analysis (expect peaks at ~65-70bp and ~100bp; final library peak ~173bp).
Sequence barcodes independently or as a fraction of the endogenous cDNA library, aiming for 3,000-5,000 read pairs per cell.
